status.description: Provider's current file-processing state, if available.

createdAt.description: File creation instant normalized to UTC Z with exact source fractional-second precision.

downloadUrl.description: Provider's available download location, without a permanence or absolute-URL guarantee; omitted when unavailable.

BulkFiles.description: Bulk-file metadata, processing state, and available download location for the connected API key.

syncs.name: sync-saved-leads

id.description: Opaque search-document identifier for this person/company lead.

personId.description: Opaque person identifier, distinct from the document identifier.

connectionsCount.description: Reported LinkedIn connection count, without an exactness guarantee.

companyDescription.description: Company metadata description as ordinary text.

phoneNumberAvailable.description: Whether phone enrichment is reported available; not the phone number itself.

SavedLeads.description: A previously searched person/company lead with identity, professional context, and company references.

functions.name: batch-enrich-companies
functions.description: Submit a native company-search enrichment file request for up to 1,000 matching companies. Company enrichment costs 0.5 credit per company.

name.description: Human-readable name for the requested bulk company file.

filters.description: Company, website, funding, and hiring criteria; omission means no restriction.

additionalProperties.description: At least one calendar-date bound for a company event.

lists.description: Include/exclude selections; unsupported exclusion combinations are rejected.

exclude.description: Criterion values to exclude where supported.

additionalProperties.description: At least one inclusion or exclusion selection.

ranges.description: Numeric ranges. Revenue retains unspecified provider monetary units; bounce rate is percentage points; website visits are monthly and duration is seconds.

maximum.description: Upper numeric bound in the criterion's stated units.

minimum.description: Lower numeric bound in the criterion's stated units.

additionalProperties.description: At least one numeric bound for a company criterion.

booleans.description: Explicit true/false characteristic restrictions; omit for no restriction.

additionalProperties.description: Required presence or absence of this company characteristic.

lastFundingWindow.description: Provider-defined relative window for the latest funding announcement; evaluated by the provider at submission.

searchType.description: Select all matching company data, new data, or previously searched data.

maxCompanies.description: Maximum companies requested for this native job; public maximum 1,000 is provisional.

FunctionInput_a_leads_batchenrichcompani.description: Submit a named, bounded company enrichment file request with optional search criteria.

id.description: Opaque bulk-file identifier for get-bulk-file; establishes accepted submission, not completion or per-company enrichment success.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_batchenrichcompan.description: Accepted company enrichment submission, identified by its bulk file ID.

tags.instructions: Use this for a company intelligence file, not a single profile (`get-company`) or similar-company discovery (`search-similar-companies`). Maximum requested batch is 1,000 companies. Save the returned id and call `get-bulk-file` later. Submission is not file completion, and repeating it may create another billable file.

functions.name: batch-enrich-leads
functions.description: Submit a native batch search and enrichment request for up to 1,000 matching leads, returning a bulk-file identifier rather than waiting for file completion.

filters.description: Typed lead/company criteria; omitted criteria impose no restriction.

dates.description: Calendar-date windows, never converted to UTC instants.

additionalProperties.description: One or both calendar-date bounds for a criterion.

lists.description: Include/exclude selections; unsupported exclusions are rejected.

exclude.description: Values to exclude where that exclusion is supported.

include.description: Values to include using provider matching semantics.

additionalProperties.description: One or both include/exclude selections for a criterion.

ranges.description: Numeric ranges; experience/job durations are months, visits monthly, visit duration seconds, and bounce rate percentage points. Monetary units/currency are provider-defined and unspecified.

maximum.description: Upper numeric bound in the selected criterion's units.

minimum.description: Lower numeric bound in the selected criterion's units.

additionalProperties.description: One or both numeric bounds for a criterion.

booleans.description: Explicit required characteristic flags; omission means unrestricted.

additionalProperties.description: Required presence or absence of the named characteristic.

companyStatus.description: Restrict results by company lifecycle status.

strictIndustries.description: Require exact industry matches rather than related industries.

jobTitleMatchMode.description: Exact, substring, or semantic title matching.

smartTitleSensitivity.description: Sensitivity only for smart title matching; default normal in smart mode.

maxLeads.description: Maximum matching leads requested for this native job; public maximum 1,000 is provisional, not an unlimited-export flag.

searchType.description: Select all matching data, previously unsearched data, or previously searched data.

enrichPhone.description: Request phones; documented cost is 15 credits per lead with a phone.

enrichWorkEmail.description: Request work emails; documented cost is one credit per lead with an email.

enrichPersonalEmail.description: Request personal emails; documented bulk cost is one extra credit, totaling two when combined with work email.

includePartialLeads.description: Enrich partial leads without emails; documented cost is 0.5 credit per lead.

FunctionInput_a_leads_batchenrichleads.description: Matching criteria, maximum lead count, and explicit enrichment choices for one native batch submission.

id.description: Opaque bulk-file identifier for get-bulk-file; establishes submission acceptance, not completion or per-lead success.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_batchenrichleads.description: Accepted batch submission identifier; file processing completes separately.

tags.instructions: Use this for a lead enrichment file, not one-page browsing (`search-leads`) or one person's email (`find-work-email`). Choose the credit-bearing enrichment options deliberately. Maximum requested batch is 1,000 leads. Save the returned id and call `get-bulk-file` later; `list-bulk-files` can recover earlier file IDs. Submission does not mean the file is finished or every lead was enriched.

functions.name: create-reverse-email-lookup
functions.description: Create an asynchronous lookup job to find a LinkedIn profile associated with an email address.

email.description: Email address whose associated LinkedIn identity should be looked up, preserving case.

FunctionInput_a_leads_createreverseemail.description: Email address to submit for an asynchronous reverse lookup.

id.description: Opaque lookup job identifier to pass as lookupId to get-reverse-email-lookup.

email.description: Email returned for the lookup job.

status.description: Provider's initial job state, such as queued; not a completion guarantee.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_createreverseemai.description: Accepted reverse-email lookup job, not a completed profile match.

tags.instructions: Use this to identify a person from a known email, not to assess deliverability; use `verify-email` for that. Save the returned id and call `get-reverse-email-lookup` later. This returns job acceptance rather than waiting for lookup completion. Do not blindly repeat submission after an ambiguous outcome because it may create another job.

functions.name: find-personal-email
functions.description: Find a personal email associated with a LinkedIn profile. The documented cost is five credits only when an email is found.

linkedInProfile.description: LinkedIn profile URL or username for the person, passed as ordinary text.

FunctionInput_a_leads_findpersonalemail.description: LinkedIn identity to look up for a personal email.

email.description: Found personal email address, or null when no address was found.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_findpersonalemail.description: Personal-email lookup result, including an explicit null for no match.

tags.instructions: Use a LinkedIn username or profile URL, available from `search-leads`. Use `find-work-email` for professional email or `verify-email` for a known address. A successful personal-email match costs five credits; null is a normal no-match result. Avoid repeating calls unnecessarily.

functions.name: find-phone-number
functions.description: Find a person's phone number using a LinkedIn profile URL or username.

linkedInProfile.description: Person's LinkedIn profile URL or username, passed as ordinary text.

FunctionInput_a_leads_findphonenumber.description: LinkedIn identity to use for phone discovery.

phoneNumber.description: Found telephone number in provider formatting, or null if no number is found; no inferred country code is added.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_findphonenumber.description: Phone discovery result, preserving provider telephone formatting.

tags.instructions: Use a LinkedIn username or URL, such as one returned by `search-leads`. A null result is a normal no-match. Use `find-work-email` or `find-personal-email` for email enrichment instead. This may be chargeable enrichment; avoid blind repeat calls.

functions.name: find-work-email
functions.description: Find a person's professional email from their name and company website. Optionally associate enrichment with an advanced-search document so it is stored for the account.

lastName.description: Person's family name as ordinary text; mapping resolves an inconsistent upstream description.

firstName.description: Person's given name as ordinary text.

documentId.description: Optional id from search-leads for this exact person/company result. Including it stores enrichment for the account and changes repeat-credit behavior; omit for externally sourced people.

companyWebsite.description: Company domain or website, such as abc-tech.com.

FunctionInput_a_leads_findworkemail.description: Person and company information for a professional email lookup, with optional search-document association.

email.description: Found professional email, if provided; absence means the provider returned no address.

result.description: Provider's finder outcome, preserved without inventing an outcome enum.

quality.description: Provider's quality label, such as good.

catchAll.description: Whether the provider reports catch-all behavior for the address/domain.

lastName.description: Family name returned by the finder.

firstName.description: Given name returned by the finder.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_findworkemail.description: Professional email finder results returned by A-Leads; unavailable optional fields are omitted.

tags.instructions: Use `search-leads` first when possible and include its document ID to store the email and avoid repeat charges for the same data. Without a document ID, the email is not stored and every repeated query is charged. Use `find-personal-email` for a personal address or `verify-email` to assess a known address. Supply the person's given/family names and company website.

functions.name: get-bulk-file
functions.description: Get the current processing status and available download location of one bulk file.

fileId.description: Opaque bulk-file identifier returned by a batch request or list-bulk-files.

FunctionInput_a_leads_getbulkfile.description: Identifies the bulk file whose current processing status should be read.

id.description: Requested bulk-file identifier, echoed for correlation.

status.description: Provider's processing state, such as completed; open string preserves undocumented states.

downloadUrl.description: Provider-returned download location when available; not assumed permanent or guaranteed to be an absolute URL.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_getbulkfile.description: Current bulk-file processing status and its download location when available.

tags.instructions: Use an id from `batch-enrich-leads`, `batch-enrich-companies`, or `list-bulk-files`. This makes one status check and does not wait for completion or download bytes. If the file is still processing, check again later. A returned download location may be temporary; its lifetime is not documented.

functions.name: get-company
functions.description: Get a company's profile, contact information, funding, workforce, web metrics, and news by company ID. Each call costs one credit.

companyId.description: Opaque decimal company identifier returned by lead or similar-company search; do not interpret it as a number.

FunctionInput_a_leads_getcompany.description: Company identifier for a single billable profile lookup.

summary.description: Article summary or null if unavailable.

publishedAt.description: Article publication instant in UTC at whole-second precision.

ipoAt.description: Reported IPO instant normalized to UTC, with whole-second precision.

isB2b.description: Whether the company primarily sells to businesses.

status.description: Provider's company lifecycle status, such as active.

isPublic.description: Whether the company is publicly listed.

acquiredAt.description: Reported acquisition instant normalized to UTC, with whole-second precision.

personId.description: Opaque executive parent/person reference; relationship interpretation requires validation.

socialUrls.description: Social profiles keyed by service name: twitter, youtube, facebook, instagram, or crunchbase.

additionalProperties.description: Reported profile URL for the named social service.

webMetrics.description: Metrics keyed by bounceRatePercent, globalRank, countryRank, categoryRank, pagesPerVisit, monthlyVisits, monthlyVisitsChange, totalVisitsChange, visitDurationSeconds, or popularityScore; undocumented change units are not interpreted.

additionalProperties.description: Reported metric or null if unknown; no absent metric is synthesized.

companyType.description: Company legal or organizational type label.

description.description: Company profile description as ordinary text.

capabilities.description: Flags keyed by demoAvailable, downloadable, pricingAvailable, uniqueDomain, and uniqueWebsite.

additionalProperties.description: Reported capability flag or null if unknown.

headquarters.description: Reported headquarters components; missing components are omitted.

phoneNumbers.description: Reported company telephone numbers, preserving original formatting.

items.description: Reported company telephone number in its original formatting.

annualRevenue.description: Provider-reported annual revenue; currency is unspecified, so do not assume USD.

currency.description: Provider's currency code, or null if unknown.

amountRaised.description: Reported raised amount in the accompanying currency, or null if unknown; scaling requires validation.

announcedDate.description: Announcement calendar date, unchanged from YYYY-MM-DD.

leadInvestors.description: Lead investor names; an empty array remains empty.

investorsCount.description: Number of investors, or null if unknown.

websiteTopics.description: Main website topics, or null when unknown.

employeeChanges.description: Workforce statistics keyed by current, yearly, monthly, quarterly, yearlyPercent, monthlyPercent, and quarterlyPercent.

additionalProperties.description: Reported count change or percentage-point value, as identified by its key.

employeesByRegion.description: Employee counts keyed by provider region names, with the employees_count_ prefix removed.

additionalProperties.description: Reported employee count for this provider geographic category.

metadataDescription.description: Company website metadata description as ordinary text.

employeesBySeniority.description: Employee counts keyed by provider seniority names, with the employees_count_ prefix removed.

additionalProperties.description: Reported employee count for this provider seniority category.

lastFundingRoundName.description: Name of the most recent funding round.

lastFundingAnnouncedAt.description: Most recent funding announcement instant in UTC, at whole-second precision.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_getcompany.description: The matching company profile with normalized typed facts and original text.

tags.instructions: Use a companyId from `search-leads` or `search-similar-companies`. This retrieves one company, not its employees. Each call costs one credit, including a repeated lookup; avoid unnecessary repeats.

functions.name: get-reverse-email-lookup
functions.description: Get the current state and any available LinkedIn result for a previously submitted reverse-email lookup.

lookupId.description: Opaque job id returned by create-reverse-email-lookup.

FunctionInput_a_leads_getreverseemailloo.description: Identifies the previously submitted reverse-email lookup to inspect.

status.description: Provider's current job status; open string to preserve pending, successful, and unsuccessful states.

linkedInUrl.description: Associated LinkedIn profile URL, omitted when no profile result is currently available.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_getreverseemaillo.description: Current reverse-email lookup state and any available LinkedIn result.

tags.instructions: First call `create-reverse-email-lookup` and retain its id. Use this tool once to inspect the job; if still pending, check again later rather than submitting another lookup. A returned LinkedIn URL is the lookup result, not a deliverability assessment.

functions.name: list-bulk-files
functions.description: List bulk-file records associated with the connected API key.

FunctionInput_a_leads_listbulkfiles.description: List bulk files for the connected account without arguments.

name.description: Human-readable file name, preserving empty strings if supplied by the provider.

createdAt.description: File creation instant normalized to UTC Z while preserving source fractional-second precision.

items.description: Metadata for one bulk file; does not indicate processing readiness.
Bulk-file metadata associated with the connection's API key, in provider order.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_listbulkfiles.description: The complete bulk-file metadata collection returned by A-Leads.

tags.instructions: Use this to find earlier files or recover an ID after an ambiguous batch submission. Use `get-bulk-file` with an item's id for current processing state and download location. This returns the provider's complete unpaginated collection in one response; no cursor or API key argument is needed.

functions.name: search-similar-companies
functions.description: Find one page of companies similar to one or more seed companies. Each call costs one credit.

limit.description: Requested page size; default 10 and public maximum 100, subject to provider validation.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the same seed set and page size; omit for the first page.

items.description: Seed company identifier, preserved as a decimal string.

companyIds.description: Seed company identifiers; similarity is computed for this seed set, not separate per-ID outcomes. Public maximum 100 seeds is provisional.

FunctionInput_a_leads_searchsimilarcompa.description: Seed companies and page controls for a single billable similarity search.

score.description: Opaque provider similarity score or null; not treated as a probability or percentage.

headcount.description: Reported company_headcount metric; not substituted for employeesCount.

employeesCount.description: Reported employees_count metric, distinct from headcount.

items.description: A similar company with the discovery metadata supplied by A-Leads.
Similar companies in provider order for this page.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for identical seeds and limit; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_searchsimilarcomp.description: One provider-ordered page of similar companies.

tags.instructions: Obtain seed company IDs from `search-leads` or `get-company`. Use this for similarity discovery, not detailed company intelligence; use `get-company` for a result's full profile. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and unchanged companyIds and limit. A call costs one credit and returns one page, with a default of 10 and maximum of 100 results.

functions.name: verify-email
functions.description: Assess a known email address and return provider validity, quality, catch-all, and email-service information.

email.description: Email address to assess; spelling and case are preserved.

FunctionInput_a_leads_verifyemail.description: A known email address to assess with A-Leads.

result.description: Provider's assessment outcome, preserved as an open string.

isValid.description: Provider's validity assessment, not a delivery guarantee.

emailServiceProvider.description: Provider's email-service label, such as google.

FunctionOutput_a_leads_verifyemail.description: The available provider assessment fields for the supplied email address.

tags.instructions: Use this for a known address. Use `find-work-email` or `find-personal-email` to discover an address, or `create-reverse-email-lookup` to identify a LinkedIn profile from one. Verification is an assessment, not proof of delivery or consent to contact.
